about: Monthly mean air temperature (°C) and precipitation (mm) at each registered name's point on the map, 1981–2010, January first, from CHELSA V2.1 (Karger, D.N. et al. 2017, Climatologies at high resolution for the earth's land surface areas, Scientific Data 4, 170122; data: Karger et al. 2021, EnviDat, doi:10.16904/envidat.228), CC0 1.0. `point` is where it was read; a build attaches it only while the name's point is the same. A point is approximate for a large area: one value for its middle. `elevation`: metres above sea level at the point, from the Copernicus DEM GLO-90 via Open-Meteo's elevation API (CC BY 4.0; doi:10.5270/ESA-c5d3d65).
